lastCompletedStory.title: `cam triage` deterministic CLI writing rank to main

nextStoryContext: src/commands/triage.ts exports runTriage(options: RunTriageOptions): TriageResult. TriageResult = TriageSuccessResult | TriageGateFailResult | TriageGuardFailResult. The CLI: (1) checkMainUpToDate guard; (2) reads backlog from main via git show; (3) runGraphGate BEFORE any write; (4) rankIssues; (5) idempotent no-op when ranks unchanged; (6) writes rank onto every {specified,open} entry; (7) commitTreeToMain (off-main) or commitOnMain (on-main); (8) best-effort push; (9) prints sentinel CAM_TRIAGE_RANKED=<n> changed=<m> sha=<sha|none>. 16 in-process tests in test/triage.test.ts cover ordering, idempotency, sentinel output, and gate failures. US-005 (real-git end-to-end proof) must verify: ranks land on main via a real git tmpdir; work-branch HEAD is unchanged; second run is a no-op; all verified via real git commands (not injected fakes).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure algorithm + git-plumbing story: no external npm library was introduced or changed. triage.ts imports only from internal modules (./gate.ts, ./rank.ts, ../git/on-main.ts, ../issues/types.ts, ../logging/color.ts).
